facts.text: The University of Cincinnati invented cooperative education (co-op) in 1906.

facts.text: Students in mandatory co-op programs must complete between 2 and 5 full-time, paid co-op terms before graduation.

sources.title: Co-op - Campus Life | University of Cincinnati
sources.quote: These programs require 2–5 full-time co-op terms (at least 35 hours/week for 15–18 weeks each) before graduation.
